3: Thus have I appeared before you in the sanctuary, that I might see your power and your glory.
4: For your mercy is better than life: my lips shall praise you.
5: Thus will I bless you during my life: I will lift up my hands in your name.
6: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness; and [my] joyful lips shall praise your name.
7: Forasmuch as I have remembered you on my bed: in the early seasons I have meditated on you.
8: For you have been my helper, and in the shelter of your wings will I rejoice.
9: My soul has kept very close behind you: your right hand has upheld me.
10: But they vainly sought after my soul; they shall go into the lowest parts o the earth.
11: They shall be delivered up to the power of the sword; they shall be portions for foxes.
12: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that swears by him shall be praised; for the mouth of them that speak unjust things has been stopped.
